description: One child has a general anaesthetic from eight to ten in the morning, with blood pressures on its record taken twenty and ten minutes before the start and ten and twenty minutes after the end.

expectations.says: The readings taken ten minutes before the start and ten minutes after the end point at the anaesthetic, because each falls within the margin of 15 minutes.
expectations.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS readings, MIN(m.value_as_number) AS lowest, MAX(m.value_as_number) AS highest FROM omop.measurement m JOIN omop.anaesthetic a ON a.anaesthetic_id = m.measurement_event_id JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = a.visit_detail_id WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990001631' AND m.measurement_concept_id = 3004249

expectations.says: The readings taken twenty minutes before the start and twenty minutes after the end do not point at the anaesthetic, and both still carry its visit detail.
expectations.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS readings, MIN(m.value_as_number) AS lowest, MAX(m.value_as_number) AS highest FROM omop.measurement m JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = m.visit_detail_id WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990001631' AND m.measurement_concept_id = 3004249 AND m.measurement_event_id IS NULL
